india_context.procedural_notes: Under Order VI Rule 1 and Order VII Rule 1 CPC, pleadings must contain concise statements of material facts but not evidence by which they are to be proved.
india_context.transitional_notes: Specific Performance claims under Specific Relief Act 1963 as amended in 2018 are mandatory remedies unless falling under statutory exceptions.
verification_requirements: Verify readiness and willingness averment under Section 16(c) of Specific Relief Act 1963.
